name: merlinclips-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server and ElizaOS Plugin for Merlin Clips autonomous creator payout campaigns on Base.

tools.name: merlinclips_create_campaign
tools.description: Open a new short-form video clip bounty campaign with a locked CPM rate and 24h retention hold. The campaign opens unfunded: it is invisible to creators and accepts no clips until USDC is on-chain behind its pool and an operator approves it.

brief.description: Clip requirements and brief rules for Gemini AI verifier

budgetUsdc.description: Total campaign pool budget in USDC

cpmRateUsdc.description: USDC payout rate per 1,000 verified views

tools.name: merlinclips_submit_clip
tools.description: Register a submitted short-form video URL (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, IG Reels, X) for retention tracking.

tools.name: merlinclips_verify_retention
tools.description: Query Gemini AI brief compliance and 24h view survival rate for a submission.

tools.name: merlinclips_get_ledger
tools.description: Retrieve the public, immutable on-chain USDC settlement ledger and BaseScan transaction hashes.

tools.name: merlinclips_check_campaign_funding
tools.description: Read what is actually on-chain behind a campaign pool, as covered, partial, empty, unknown or no_wallet. A campaign waiting on funding whose pool reads covered moves into the operator approval queue.
